absorb.en: Dark surfaces absorb more heat from sunlight than light ones.
absorb.zh: 深色表面比淺色表面吸收更多陽光熱能。

accessible.en: The new website makes school information more accessible to students.
accessible.zh: 新網站讓學生更容易取得學校資訊。

accompany.en: A short explanation should accompany each chart in the report.
accompany.zh: 報告中的每張圖表都應附上一段簡短說明。

aggregate.en: The researchers used aggregate data instead of individual records.
aggregate.zh: 研究人員使用彙總資料，而不是個別紀錄。

allocate.en: The committee will allocate additional funds to improve library resources.
allocate.zh: 委員會將分配額外經費來改善圖書館資源。

alter.en: A small change in temperature can alter the experiment results.
alter.zh: 溫度的小幅變化可能改變實驗結果。

amend.en: The team decided to amend the plan after reviewing new evidence.
amend.zh: 團隊檢視新證據後決定修正計畫。

appreciable.en: There was an appreciable improvement after students changed their study routine.
appreciable.zh: 學生改變讀書方式後出現了明顯進步。

assemble.en: Students assemble the model carefully before testing its strength.
assemble.zh: 學生在測試模型強度前仔細將它組裝完成。

attain.en: Regular practice can help students attain a higher level of accuracy.
attain.zh: 規律練習可以幫助學生達到更高的準確度。

authorize.en: Only the teacher can authorize access to the locked equipment room.
authorize.zh: 只有老師能授權進入上鎖的器材室。

beneficial.en: Short review sessions can be beneficial before a major exam.
beneficial.zh: 大考前進行短時間複習可能很有幫助。

capable.en: The new device is capable of measuring very small changes accurately.
capable.zh: 這台新裝置能精確測量非常微小的變化。

coincide.en: The two deadlines coincide, so the schedule needs to be adjusted.
coincide.zh: 兩個截止日期重疊，因此時程需要調整。

commence.en: The final presentation will commence after all groups are seated.
commence.zh: 所有小組就座後，期末報告將開始。

compensate.en: Extra study time may compensate for lessons missed during an absence.
compensate.zh: 額外讀書時間可能彌補缺席期間錯過的課程。

concurrent.en: The school avoided scheduling concurrent exams for the same students.
concurrent.zh: 學校避免為同一批學生安排同時進行的考試。

conform.en: All reports must conform to the format described in the instructions.
conform.zh: 所有報告都必須符合說明中規定的格式。

conserve.en: Turning off unused lights can conserve energy throughout the school day.
conserve.zh: 關掉不用的燈可以在整個上課日節省能源。

constrain.en: Limited space can constrain the number of experiments performed at once.
constrain.zh: 空間有限可能限制同時進行的實驗數量。

consult.en: Students should consult reliable sources before making a strong claim.
consult.zh: 學生提出明確主張前應查閱可靠資料來源。

convey.en: The diagram can convey complex information more clearly than a long paragraph.
convey.zh: 圖解能比長篇文字更清楚傳達複雜資訊。

correlate.en: Researchers found that study time may correlate with test performance.
correlate.zh: 研究人員發現讀書時間可能與測驗表現相關。

deduct.en: The teacher may deduct points if the required steps are missing.
deduct.zh: 如果缺少必要步驟，老師可能會扣分。

depict.en: The map depicts how the coastline changed over several decades.
depict.zh: 這張地圖描繪海岸線數十年間的變化。

discrete.en: The survey divided responses into several discrete categories.
discrete.zh: 這份調查把回答分成幾個明確區分的類別。

dispose.en: Students must dispose of used materials according to laboratory rules.
dispose.zh: 學生必須依照實驗室規定處理使用過的材料。

distort.en: A poor scale can distort the way data appear on a graph.
distort.zh: 不恰當的比例尺可能扭曲資料在圖表上的呈現方式。

duration.en: The duration of the experiment was exactly thirty minutes.
duration.zh: 這項實驗的持續時間正好是三十分鐘。

elicit.en: The teacher used a question to elicit ideas from the class.
elicit.zh: 老師用一個問題引導全班提出想法。

equate.en: Students should not equate popularity with the reliability of information.
equate.zh: 學生不應把受歡迎程度等同於資訊的可靠性。

exhibit.en: The museum will exhibit several student projects during the science week.
exhibit.zh: 博物館將在科學週展示幾項學生專題。

facilitate.en: Clear instructions facilitate smoother teamwork during complex group activities.
facilitate.zh: 清楚的指示有助於複雜小組活動中的合作更順利。

finite.en: The project had a finite budget, so every expense was carefully planned.
finite.zh: 這項專題的預算有限，因此每筆支出都經過仔細規劃。

fundamental.en: Reading comprehension is a fundamental skill for many school subjects.
fundamental.zh: 閱讀理解是許多學科中的基本能力。

incidental.en: The report mentioned several incidental details that were not central to the conclusion.
incidental.zh: 報告提到幾個與主要結論無關的次要細節。

induce.en: Bright light can induce faster growth in some types of plants.
induce.zh: 強光可能促使某些植物生長得更快。

inherent.en: Every method has inherent limits that researchers need to consider.
inherent.zh: 每種方法都有研究人員需要考量的固有限制。

invoke.en: The program will invoke a backup process if the main system fails.
invoke.zh: 如果主系統失效，程式會啟動備援流程。

mediate.en: A teacher helped mediate the disagreement between the two groups.
mediate.zh: 老師協助調解兩組之間的意見分歧。

offset.en: The new schedule may offset some of the time lost earlier.
offset.zh: 新的時程可能彌補先前損失的一部分時間。

precede.en: A short introduction will precede the main presentation.
precede.zh: 主要簡報之前會先有一段簡短介紹。

predominant.en: Blue was the predominant color used in the final design.
predominant.zh: 藍色是最終設計中使用最多的顏色。

prohibit.en: School rules prohibit students from entering the laboratory without supervision.
prohibit.zh: 校規禁止學生在無人監督下進入實驗室。

random.en: The researchers selected a random sample from the student population.
random.zh: 研究人員從學生族群中選取隨機樣本。

regulate.en: The device can regulate temperature automatically during the experiment.
regulate.zh: 這個裝置能在實驗過程中自動調節溫度。

relocate.en: The school plans to relocate several classrooms during the renovation.
relocate.zh: 學校計畫在整修期間搬遷幾間教室。

render.en: Poor lighting can render small text difficult to read.
render.zh: 光線不足可能讓小字變得難以閱讀。

restrain.en: The safety belt helps restrain movement during sudden stops.
restrain.zh: 安全帶能在突然停止時限制身體移動。

subordinate.en: The report treats cost as subordinate to student safety.
subordinate.zh: 這份報告把成本視為次於學生安全的考量。

trigger.en: A sudden temperature change can trigger an automatic warning.
trigger.zh: 溫度突然改變可能觸發自動警示。

uniform.en: The samples were kept under uniform conditions throughout the experiment.
uniform.zh: 所有樣本在整個實驗期間都維持一致條件。

voluntary.en: Participation in the after-school survey is completely voluntary.
voluntary.zh: 參加課後問卷完全是自願的。
